members.name: renderTargets
members.description: Scene render targets. You can add multiple of them and use them in your passes / shaders.

members.name: output
members.description: Scene output target, used as pixels for the sprite. For it to take effect, see setOutputDisplay().

members.name: outputColorIndex
members.description: The color index for the colorBuffers render target. Must be 0 if MRTs are not supported. For it to take effect, see setOutputDisplay().

members.name: foxGroup
members.description: A FoxGroup containing all of foxlite's active objects (including other groups).

members.name: foxCameras
members.description: An array containing FoxCameras, intended to be used globally.

members.name: environment
members.description: The scene environment, a holder object for global environment variables such as sky textures. Subject to change in the future.

members.name: drawGroups
members.description: An array of BalancedTree containing sorted draw data, calculated per frame and processed per camera. Draw groups consist of a collection of materials and meshes that can be drawn at once in a target, which must exist on the scene as a FoxFramebuffer in renderTargets. Meant for post-processing, offscreen rendering and shadow passes.

members.name: timeScale
members.description: Multiplier applied to the elapsed time on update.

members.name: context
members.description: The Context3D used to render this scene.

members.name: onFramebufferResized
members.description: Dispatched whenever the scene's back buffer is resized.

members.name: onPreDraw
members.description: Dispatched right before the scene draws its cameras.

members.name: onPostDraw
members.description: Dispatched right after the scene draws its cameras.

functions.name: new
functions.description: Creates a new FoxScene with the given back buffer size.

functions.name: add
functions.description: Adds a member to the scene's foxGroup.

functions.name: insert
functions.description: Inserts a member at the given position in foxGroup.

functions.name: setupBuffers
functions.description: Sets up (or resizes) the scene's default back buffer render target.

functions.name: setOutputDisplay
functions.description: Sets which render target and color buffer index will be displayed as the scene's sprite pixels.

functions.name: isOnScreen
functions.description: Always returns true, disabling flixel culling for the scene sprite.

functions.name: update
functions.description: Updates the scene's cameras and every active member of foxGroup, scaled by timeScale.

functions.name: draw
functions.description: Draws every visible camera in the scene, rebuilding draw groups if needed.

functions.name: addDrawGroup
functions.description: Adds a new draw group and returns its index.

functions.name: buildDrawGroups
functions.description: Computes the draw groups indexed by materials, reducing draw calls and state switches.

functions.name: addToDrawGroups
functions.description: Adds a material along with a mesh to be drawn by groups, providing a FoxObject for transforms. Intended for internal use.

functions.name: disposeBuffers
functions.description: Destroys and clears every render target on this scene.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Destroys every camera, the environment, foxGroup and render targets on this scene.
